question: which Indian state does not share border with Bangladesh as of 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihar **does **not** share a border with **Bangladesh.**
 
• **Meghalaya, West Bengal, and Mizoram** share a border with Bangladesh.
 
• Bihar is located in the** northern part of India** and does not share a border with Bangladesh, which is located in the **eastern part of India.**
 
• Bangladesh shares borders with five Indian states -** West Bengal, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Tripura, and Assam.**
 
• The main keyword in the question is "border," which refers to the **geographical boundary** between two countries or states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meghalaya** is a state located in the **northeast region** of India and shares a** 443 km long** border with Bangladesh.
 
• **West Bengal** is a state located in the **eastern region** of India and shares a **2,216 km long** border with Bangladesh, which is the longest international border in India.
 
• **Mizoram **is a state located in the **northeast region** of India and shares a **318 km long **border with Bangladesh.
 
• **Bihar **is a state located in the** northern part **of India and shares borders with seven other Indian states but does not share a border with Bangladesh.
